notes: Matches the reference: it stops deduplicating at the ConfigResource level and dedups per resource instance in expandResourceImports, with good plan, apply and parent/child-override tests; the CHANGELOG.md edit is extra noise.

Matches the reference: import statements are no longer collapsed per resource, and parent-over-child precedence is now decided per resource instance after expansion; it adds solid plan and apply regression tests, including the parent/child override case, but also includes a CHANGELOG edit with a guessed issue number.

Fixes the same-module case but keeps config-time dedup through brittle static parsing of `to` that ignores module instance keys and dynamic expressions, and with no per-instance dedup at expansion a surviving child block can overwrite the parent's; it also makes unrelated child-sorting and slices.Concat changes.

Fixes the single-module for_each/count case, but keeps a fragile config-time override heuristic based on statically parsing `to` addresses and adds no instance-level dedup, so a dynamic parent import drops all of the child's blocks and keyed-module collisions can let the child override the parent; it also includes unrelated child-ordering and `slices.Concat` changes.

Simple fix for the reported single-module case, but an ancestor import on any instance still drops every child-module import for other instances of that resource (the same silent-drop bug in module form); it has only one for_each test.

Fixes the reported same-module case, but any ancestor import for a resource still silently drops every child-module import for other instances of that resource, the same class of bug as the issue; it has only one basic test.

It correctly fixes all the block-structure brace checks, with very thorough tests (backticks, heredocs, imported blocks, segment contents).
